events.title: Phuoc Thang Fort opens fire against the French
events.description: French troops used warships to attack Vung Tau estuary. Renowned generals Nguyen Trong To and Bui Quang Dieu commanded the military and civilians at Phuoc Thang Fort (Nui Lon) to fire back fiercely, setting enemy ships on fire and initially halting the French colonists' invasion plot.

events.title: Establishment of Con Dao Prison
events.description: Governor of Cochinchina Bonard signed the decision to establish Con Dao Prison. From then on, Con Dao became a 'Hell on Earth' detaining tens of thousands of patriotic and revolutionary soldiers for 113 years (1862-1975) under two colonial and imperial regimes.

events.title: Establishment of the first Party Cell (Phuoc Hai)
events.description: In Phuoc Hai fishing village, the first Communist Party Cell of Ba Ria Province was established with 3 Party members, with Comrade Tran Van Cu serving as Secretary. This was the core leading the revolutionary movement of fishermen and farmers in the Dat Do area.

events.title: Seizing power in Ba Ria
events.description: About 4,000 armed masses demonstrated and seized the Toa Bo (Governor's Palace) and the Civil Guard Camp. Province Chief Le Thanh Long surrendered. The Provisional Administrative Committee of Ba Ria Province was established, marking the victory of the August Revolution in the locality.

events.title: Vo Thi Sau's sacrifice in Con Dao
events.description: Heroine Vo Thi Sau (a daughter of the Dat Do land) was executed by firing squad by the French colonists in Hang Duong, Con Dao. Her resilient sacrifice and indomitable spirit became a sacred symbol of revolutionary heroism.

events.title: Binh Gia Victory
events.description: The main force of the Region coordinated with local military and civilians to launch the Binh Gia campaign, completely wiping out 2 main-force battalions and 1 armored squadron of the Saigon army. This victory marked the fundamental bankruptcy of the US 'Special Warfare' strategy.

events.title: Battle of Long Tan
events.description: A fierce clash between D Company (6th Battalion, Royal Australian Regiment) and units of the 275th Regiment of the Liberation Army in the Long Tan rubber plantation. This is the most famous battle involving Australian troops in the Vietnam War.

events.title: Liberation of Con Dao
events.description: Upon hearing the news of Saigon's liberation, political prisoners in Con Dao revolted, seized the prison, and took complete control of the island in the early morning of May 1, 1975, welcoming ships from the mainland. Con Dao ended its 113 years as 'Hell on Earth'.

events.title: Extraction of the first commercial ton of crude oil (Bach Ho Field)
events.description: The Vietsovpetro joint venture successfully extracted the first commercial ton of crude oil from the Bach Ho field on Vietnam's continental shelf. This event placed Vietnam on the list of oil and gas producing countries in the world, marking a turning point for the economy.

events.title: Establishment of Ba Ria - Vung Tau Province
events.description: The 8th National Assembly passed the Resolution to establish Ba Ria - Vung Tau Province on the basis of the Vung Tau - Con Dao Special Zone and 3 districts (Chau Thanh, Long Dat, Xuyen Moc) of Dong Nai Province. The province officially went into operation, becoming a center for oil and gas, seaports, and tourism.
